name: Kilt Odues
source:
A young man of incubus descent.

He is a nobleman from the Grisani family, which makes him the 13th candidate to marry the princess, but since he is at the very bottom of the family's hierarchy, his family status is not very high.

He is a womanizer and has a somewhat frivolous and carefree personality, but he is a genius researcher with top-notch skills as an alchemist who handles ancient magical tools.
